response.sql: WITH status_tallies AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), status_shares AS (SELECT archstat, tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM status_tallies) SELECT archstat, tally, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares) AS above_average_share FROM status_shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares);
